note: This skill owns RUNNING the conformance check (validate.py) and judging its findings — asking, checking, verifying naming conformance. Parsing grammar itself routes to naming-conventions; fixing a found violation routes to rename-planning; seeding governance routes to manifest-authoring; a busy-work/bloat ask routes to bloat-audit. Authored fresh at mint (2026-08-13, issue #196) — no prior eval history. Amended 2026-08-14 (issue #233): n05 added — the exact prompt fix-old-names' own evals.json carries as t10, confirmed as a cross-suite steal during PR #230's and #232's full check-routing runs (fix-old-names scored 19/20, this the only non-clean case in the plugin). Ruling: fix-old-names owns it — the prompt asks whether a repo still references RETIRED names (a sweep-and-rewrite ask), not whether current names conform to the grammar (this skill's read-only domain). The description gained the reciprocal NOT-for fence in the same change.
